verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-operation capability, such as acting on many services, deploys, or env vars in one action. The closest items are adjacent: Blueprints define an entire architecture in one YAML file (infrastructure-as-code), and the CLI, REST API and MCP server are general management tools or developer building blocks. The MCP trigger_deploy tool acts on a single existing service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
